situation: Willa is back under the forge-house roof with the recovered bar still in her custody and her hands marked by the return crossing. Before she slept she read the piece as a smith: the stamp is a lie, the mid-length weld is Orren's work from that decade, and the inclusion in the join is where a living levy sits. She has not spoken that reading. Orren is banking the night fire, still master of the house, still silent on the weld, still paying the levy in his body. The rite is six days off. The household is still the raising home, the debt account is still unsettled, and the village does not know the bar is false.

craft.audience_need: The adult band was promised a completed moral choice with a felt cost and no last-page rescue. After the solitary craft-discovery they now need the forger to speak in his own work-idiom so the forty-year reasons become audible as history and remain available as a present choice rather than a twist. They need that landing in dialogue two people can hear across a bench, not in a cut or a confession speech.
craft.genre_convention: Mystery after a reading expects a confrontation that unmasks the maker. Domestic drama expects a kitchen reckoning that clears or breaks the house. Low fantasy expects the binding to be explained as lore. This node satisfies the identification — the weld is his, said aloud — and refuses the unmasking, the cleared house, and the lore-dump: he receives the bar as his own work, names the levy as a tax he pays, and does not ask the house to go back to unread.
craft.theme_and_style: The root theme requires the old kindness to stay audible and the present lie indefensible; this scene must let him name the slide year as a fact of a bad winter and must not let her grant those reasons now. Vernacular, photographable, dialogue-led: she will say weight, weld, inclusion; he will say slide, hunger, closed pass. Forbidden here specifically: no interior sentence that names debt or theme, no omniscient dip into Orren on the page, no 'old stories said,' no fire or night weather used as moral weather, no mechanism-lecture on how a levy is bound.
craft.dramatic_function: Pays off the private reading by taking it into the only mouth that can admit the weld. Closes the question of whether the master made the piece. Sets up the unpaid ledger and the bind: once the admission is in the room, staying unread is no longer available, and deciding is not yet done. Leaves the household still a raising home so the later partition and the unforgiven naming have a house left to change.

tension_management.how: Pressure rises because a reading that lived in one pair of frosted hands becomes a shared fact with no order attached. He does not deny and does not collect her silence, so the relic sitting between them stops being a recovered village token and becomes a fraud both of them now own for six days. Nothing is released: the rite clock is untouched, the piece is unbroken, the debt is unnamed.

craft.why_now: She did not have the bar to read until the return, and she did not have a reading to bring until she sat with the mass, the weld, and the inclusion before sleep. Morning would put unfinished tithe-iron back on the floor; he will not speak first if work can postpone speaking, and another shared task would spend the last clean hour the house has. The crossing already spent the hours in which he might have told her first. Six days is already the bind. The reading has to meet him tonight, while the piece is still in her custody and the fire is only being banked.

why_not_otherwise.alternative: She takes the same reading to the village hearths or to a Hold clerk before she speaks to him.
why_not_otherwise.rejected_because: pl-02:st4 requires the reading go to him rather than to the village or the Hold. A public naming would force a challenge or a breaking, forfeit the year, and erase the relationship plot the recovery is supposed to cost.

why_not_otherwise.alternative: She puts the bar back as if unread and they finish the thin tithe first.
why_not_otherwise.rejected_because: She has already read the mass. Carrying it unread now would spend the recovery on a fraud she owns, and his habit is to file a tool rather than speak. The admission would slide onto the rite's eve and crush st6–st8 into a single night.

why_not_otherwise.alternative: He sees her handling the join and confesses unprompted.
why_not_otherwise.rejected_because: He will not speak first if work can still postpone the speaking. The story needs her to bring the metal as work she owes the man who taught her to read it, not to receive a gift-confession that would cheaply redeem the house.

why_not_otherwise.alternative: She sets the bar down as a charge — you lied, you bound me to a false weight.
why_not_otherwise.rejected_because: She thinks in work and will not dress a feeling as a principle. A verdict tonight would steal the later unforgiven naming (pl-02:st9) and turn this into the ending of the household rather than the admission of the weld.

why_not_otherwise.alternative: Admission and decision in the same scene: she hears the slide year and chooses breaking, telling, or presenting before the fire is banked.
why_not_otherwise.rejected_because: The spine separates admission (st5), present indefensibility (st6), the unpaid ledger (st7), and the partition (st8). Compressing them would give the adult reader a clean choice the story has forbidden and would leave no days in which she cannot settle what she owes.

made: What will she do with the admitted reading before the rite?
Do the slide-year reasons still govern the coming presentation, or only the year that made the weld?
kept: The recovered object, already readable as wrong by craft, is taken to the forger rather than to the village or the Hold.
The master who raised her is the man who made the forty-year piece; he will not deny the weld when it is named as metal.

psychology.entering_state: Exhausted, frost-handed, just off a private reading she has told no one. Sure of the metal, unsure whether bringing a fault in the work to the man who taught her the work is payment or theft. Still of the house by habit. Still unable to put a number on what she owes him.

perception.sight: The banked coals, his stooped shoulders, the short wrought bar as she sets it on the bench between them, the mid-length weld she already knows in firelight, her own pale stiff fingers left in view, his gaze going to the iron and not to her face.
perception.sound: The last small collapse of coals as he stops banking. The bar's short wooden knock on the bench. His breathing while he looks. Later his voice naming a slide year and a closed pass, without raising it.
perception.touch: The wrong mass of the bar still in the memory of her palm. The tight burn-ache of frost in the fingers she will not hide. Bench-wood under the side of her hand when she lets the piece go.
perception.smell: Scale, wet wool, the thin soup from earlier, smoke held in both their clothes.
perception.taste: Ash and old iron at the back of the mouth from handling the bar and from not having eaten enough after the crossing.
perception.interoception: Stamina scraped to thirty: a hollow under the ribs, the pulse sitting too near the frost in the hands, a shake she can keep out of the voice if she keeps the sentences to the metal.
perception.proprioception: Standing on the dirt-and-stone floor in the work room, weight on both feet as at the anvil, shoulders set to present an object, frosted hands open on the bench instead of in her sleeves.
perception.attention: Whether he will deny the weld or find a tool that needs filing. The inclusion she has already named to herself. She is not attending to the fact that she has come in ready to refuse an order he may not give.

appraisal.value_at_stake: True weight matters more than a stamped claim; a finished task is cleaner than a spoken thanks; the hamlet's winter is not to be spent on a private quarrel.
appraisal.moral_reading: The bar is wrong in the hand. The weld is his. He is owed that reading first because he taught her to take mass and join as facts. What the village is owed is a separate piece of work and is not tonight's.
appraisal.somatic_marker: A tightening through the frosted fingers, as when a bar on the balance does not come level and the arm must be watched until it stills.

norms_in_force: A fault found in the work is taken to the master of the fire before it is taken to the hamlet.
The house does not dress a bill as a blessing.
A woman of this forge speaks in tools, weights, and tasks.
The relic is not spoken of as a secret, because speaking of it as a secret would make it one.
social_norms.how_others_would_judge: Orren, if he is still the master of this house, will judge a reading brought as metal to be the correct first act, and a charge spoken as feeling to be a waste of the fire.
social_norms.how_absent_others_would_judge: The hearths below would call it disloyal to take a village token apart on the bench; the Hold would only care if the piece were publicly challenged or broken; the dead of her first winter have no standing anyone in this room will name.
social_norms.standing_at_risk: Her place as the smith's girl who stayed — useful at the fire, of the house, not yet a person who can make the house untrue.
social_norms.norm_conflict: Duty to bring a fault in the work to the master conflicts with duty not to endanger the hamlet's grain by making the token into a named fraud. The work-norm wins the first move: she brings it here. The grain-norm wins the last move: she does not yet take it out of the house.

theory_of_mind.d1: He made this bar and has been paying inside it. He did not tell her because he did not want her to carry the knowledge or the crossing. If she names the weld as metal he will not deny the work; he may ask her to put the reading away so the Hold never hears it.
theory_of_mind.d2: He thinks she is still the girl of this house bringing a fault in the work to be told what it is. He thinks she has not yet decided the weld is his, only that the weight is wrong.
theory_of_mind.d3: He believes she still thinks a house can be paid in work, and that if he names the slide year she will take that naming as the rest of the job and leave the bar unread in public.
theory_of_mind.accuracy: She is wrong that he will ask her to hide the reading. He will not spend her as a silence he ordered. The error costs her the refusal she came prepared to make: when no order comes she is left holding a fraud with no instruction and no chance to say no, which is how the knowledge becomes hers.

urges.cravings: The last heat of the banked fire on the frosted hands; to set the bar in his palm and have the mass become his problem again.
urges.physical_needs: Sleep, more food than the thin soup, the deep ache in the hands to be allowed to stop gripping.
urges.psych_needs_conscious: For him to hear the weight, the weld, and the inclusion as facts, so the reading is no longer only hers.
urges.psych_needs_unconscious: For the house to remain a place where a finished task still counts as payment, even after the bar is named.
urges.avoidances: Asking why he never told her. Putting the piece into his hands. Taking the same sentences down the frozen path to the meeting shed.

impairments.physical: Frost injury in both hands, still visible; stamina at thirty after the double crossing.
impairments.coercive: Six days to the rite; the hamlet's winter grain and the closed-pass threat sitting offstage; the unfinished thin tithe still on this floor.
impairments.cognitive: She cannot yet think the raising and the lie as one account. The metal is clear; the debt is not a shape she can put on the balance.
impairments.net_effect: She can name weld, mass, and inclusion with a worker's precision and cannot ask what the house is owed. She will under-ask and leave the next act unspoken.

deliberation.framing: This is a reading of metal the man who taught the reading is owed to hear before anyone else. If the work is brought clean, the next task will show itself.

options_weighed.option: Take the bar and the reading to the hearths or to a Hold clerk in the morning.
options_weighed.predicted_outcome: Someone will challenge or break the piece; the pass closes; the winter grain stops.
options_weighed.cost: The hamlet's winter spent on a truth the Hold did not ask to test.

options_weighed.option: Wrap the bar and go to sleep as if the mass had not been felt.
options_weighed.predicted_outcome: They will finish the thin tithe on a fraud she has already read.
options_weighed.cost: The recovery spent on a lie she now owns, and another day in which he can file a tool instead of speak.

options_weighed.option: Set the bar between them and say the weight, the weld, the inclusion, nothing else.
options_weighed.predicted_outcome: He will have to meet the metal. The house will still have a chance to speak before the village does.
options_weighed.cost: Once the sentences are in the room she cannot put the bar back as unread, and she still will not know what she owes him.

deliberation.reasoning: The stamp is wrong for the mass. The weld is his from that decade. The inclusion is not a flourish. A reading like that goes to the fire it was made in, not down the path. If she takes it out of the house she spends the winter. If she puts it back she spends the walk she already paid in her hands. So the bar goes on the bench and the words stay the names of what the iron is.
deliberation.chosen_because: It keeps the hamlet's winter off the table and treats the man who taught her as the first person owed the work, which is the only payment she trusts.
deliberation.known_unknowns: She does not know if he will deny. She does not know if he will ask her to hide it. She does not know what she will say if he does. She hedges by keeping custody of the bar and by not asking a question that would force an answer about the Hold.

control.felt: The bar is his lie and her raising is inside the same join. The hands hurt. She wants the mass to belong to him again.
control.expressed: The relic set down without a preface. Sentences about wrong weight, a forty-year weld, an inclusion. Frosted hands left in the light. No charge, no question.
control.divergence_reason: She will not dress a feeling as a principle, and a charge would make this a verdict. The house still runs on work spoken as work.
control.leakage: The damaged hands kept deliberately in view — the crossing's price shown, not said. She does not wrap the bar or move it back toward the chest-cloth. A half-second in which she could have asked why, and does not.
control.inhibited_impulse: To put the piece in his hands. To ask why he never told her. To say the house has been paying her in a false weight.

psychology.intention: Make him hear the metal as metal, in this room, before anyone else, and keep the next act unchosen.
psychology.action: She brings the bar from the bench into the work room, sets it between them, keeps her frost-marked hands visible, and lays out the wrong weight, the weld, and the inclusion as facts. She lets him finish the slide-year account. She does not answer what she will do with the knowledge or the piece.

trajectory.shift: She converts a private reading into a presented object. The knowledge leaves her skull and becomes something that can be filmed: a bar on a bench, sentences in the work room.
trajectory.trigger: She sets the relic down between them and does not preface it.

trajectory.phase: after he receives the weld as his
trajectory.shift: The prepared refusal has nothing to attach to. She is no longer the only person who knows, and she is still the person holding the bar.
trajectory.trigger: He does not deny forging it or binding the levy to himself, and he does not ask what she intends before he speaks of how it was made.

trajectory.phase: after the slide year is named
trajectory.shift: The old reasons enter her hearing as history. She does not grant them. She does not close the next act. The debt stays a shape she cannot weigh.
trajectory.trigger: He names the hunger of that winter and the closed pass as the ground of the weld, as history, not as a plea.

psychology.leaving_state: The reading is no longer only hers. She has heard the slide year and has not granted it. She is still of the house by location and habit, still unable to settle the ledger, still holding the bar, waiting for an order that did not come.
psychology.unresolved: What she will do with the admitted reading in the six days before the rite, and what the raising is worth now that the raising includes the weld.

psychology.entering_state: Master of the house, banking the night fire, still withholding the weld, still paying the levy, still hoping another winter can be bought without the Hold testing the piece and without Willa having to carry either the knowledge or the crossing. The girl who can read the join as his is in the room with the bar.

perception.sight: The short bar coming off the bench in her hands. The frost- paleness of those hands left in the light on purpose. The mid-length weld he has not let himself look at as work in years. Her face doing no accusation, only the set she uses when a measurement is wrong.
perception.sound: The knock of iron on wood. The fire dropping as he stops the poker. Her voice using the names he taught her — weight, weld, inclusion — without a charge around them.
perception.touch: The poker still warm in his palm, then not. The draft he always sits nearer than the work requires. He does not touch the bar.
perception.smell: The same scale and smoke as every night, suddenly specific because the piece that feeds on him is in the room unwrapped.
perception.taste: Nothing he will notice; he has not eaten enough to have a taste left.
perception.interoception: The old cold that is the levy and the draft together, worse when the work stops. A drop in the gut when the weld is named as his decade. Wrists tired from a day he should not have stood so long.
perception.proprioception: Stooped at the hearth, then still, poker lowered, body angled to the bench rather than to her, as if the bar were a piece of stock to be judged.
perception.attention: The weld. Whether she will say Hold or village next. He is not attending to the fact that she has not asked him what to do, only told him what the iron is.

appraisal.value_at_stake: A village still standing outweighs a clean name at the Hold; craft should be true even when the compact is not; he will not spend Willa as a fighter or as a confession.
appraisal.moral_reading: She has read the join correctly. Denying the work would make the craft false as well as the compact. The slide year was a year the hearths would have gone out. That is a fact of that winter, not a claim on this one, and he will not dress it as a blessing.
appraisal.somatic_marker: Cold coming up through the wrists the moment the work stops, the same cold he calls the draft.

norms_in_force: A master receives a fault in the work without calling it a feeling.
The house does not ask pardon for a bill still being paid.
The relic is not to be spoken of as a secret.
He does not collect a debt against the girl he raised.
social_norms.how_others_would_judge: Willa, if she is still his apprentice tonight, will judge a denial as a false edge and a plea as worse.
social_norms.how_absent_others_would_judge: The hamlet would call the weld a theft of forty winters if they heard it; the Hold would only move if the piece were challenged or broken; the children of the slide year are grown and would not thank him in a way he would accept.
social_norms.standing_at_risk: Master of this house, the man whose fire the hamlet has. If she takes the reading out of the room he is a forger with a closed pass. If he orders her silence he has spent her.
social_norms.norm_conflict: Keep the village standing by keeping the piece unread versus keep the craft true by admitting the weld when it is put in front of him. Craft wins the sentences. The village still wins the piece remaining unbroken and unchallenged tonight.

theory_of_mind.d1: She has read the weld as his and brought the bar here instead of down the path, which means the house still holds her. She wants the metal confirmed and she wants to be told the year that required it.
theory_of_mind.d2: She thinks he will deny, or find a tool to file, or ask her to put the reading away so the Hold never hears it. She thinks he still believes the old year covers this one.
theory_of_mind.d3: She believes he believes she came as a daughter of the house to be given a reason she can grant, and that naming the slide will let them go back to the tithe in the morning as the same household.
theory_of_mind.accuracy: He is wrong that bringing the bar here means the house still holds her as home. She brought a reading of metal to the smith who taught the reading; that is work, not belonging. The error will cost him the next days: he will speak the old reasons as if they can still be heard inside a household, and she will hear them only as past, and he will not understand why the house is already changing under the same roof.

urges.cravings: To sit nearer the coals. To take the bar out of her damaged hands. To have her go to the loft and leave the weld unnamed until after the rite.
urges.physical_needs: Heat, rest, the levy's cold to be called a draft and not discussed.
urges.psych_needs_conscious: Another winter of grain without a test. Willa not carrying this.
urges.psych_needs_unconscious: For the slide year to still be enough if he names it cleanly, even though he knows it is not.
urges.avoidances: Asking her to hide the reading. Asking to be forgiven. Looking at her hands long enough that the crossing becomes a thing he did to her.

impairments.physical: Age, stoop, body_condition at fifty-four; wrists failing first; he cannot have made the crossing she just made.
impairments.medical: none beyond the long thinness that poverty and the levy share without remark.
impairments.magical: The living levy bound into the inclusion is still being paid; it cannot be transferred, paused, or put down by any act available in this room.
impairments.coercive: The midwinter compact six days off; the Hold's untested showing still required; the hamlet's hunger if the piece is broken or late.
impairments.cognitive: He cannot yet think this year separately from the year the original went down the slope. The old reasons arrive as facts before he can stop them.
impairments.net_effect: He can admit the weld as his work and will offer history instead of a present defense. He cannot ask her to carry silence and cannot stop paying.

deliberation.framing: The bar has come back to the fire that made it. The work has been named. The year that required the weld is the only true account he has to give.

options_weighed.option: Deny, or turn to a tool that needs filing.
options_weighed.predicted_outcome: She has the weld. Denial would make him false in the craft as well as in the compact.
options_weighed.cost: The one value he has left that is not the lie.

options_weighed.option: Ask her to hide the reading from the Hold and from the hearths.
options_weighed.predicted_outcome: She might obey tonight. The year might be bought.
options_weighed.cost: He would have spent her as a confession. He will not.

options_weighed.option: Admit the weld and the levy, give the slide year as history, and not ask what she will do.
options_weighed.predicted_outcome: She will have the truth of the metal and the old reasons. The next act will be hers.
options_weighed.cost: She will carry the knowledge he wanted to keep off her, and he will not know if the house still stands in the morning.

deliberation.reasoning: The join is his. Saying otherwise is a false edge. The original went down in a slide year the hearths would not have stood. That is what happened. Asking her to hide it would put her in the levy beside him. Asking pardon would dress a bill as a blessing. So he names the work and the year and leaves the Hold unasked.
deliberation.chosen_because: Craft should be true even when the compact is not, and he will not spend her. History is the only form he has that is not a plea.
deliberation.known_unknowns: He does not know if she will take the reading out of the house. He does not know if she still thinks work can pay the raising. He hedges by not asking her intention before he speaks, so that whatever she does is not an answer to an order.

control.felt: The thing he has feared is on the bench. Relief that she brought it here. Grief that she had to. Shame that the hands that set it down are damaged from a walk he could not make.
control.expressed: He stops banking. He looks at the piece, not at her. He does not deny the weld or the levy. He names the slide year, the hunger, the closed pass, as facts of a bad year. He does not ask her to hide the reading and does not ask what she will do.
control.divergence_reason: He names work, years, and weather, and lets feeling go unnamed. A plea would ask the old year to cover this one out loud.
control.leakage: He looks at the iron instead of at her face. The poker comes down and stays down. He does not step nearer the bar. When he says the reasons were good then, the word then is the only present judgment he allows.
control.inhibited_impulse: To ask her to put the reading away until after the showing. To take the bar. To ask pardon. To look at her hands and say he did not want her to walk.

psychology.intention: Admit the work without collecting her silence and without asking the old year to be granted as this one.
psychology.action: He stops the fire-work, receives the weld as his and the inclusion as his tax, states that the original was lost in a slide year the village could not have survived, offers those reasons as history, and does not ask her to hide the reading or take it to the Hold.

trajectory.phase: on the bar being set down
trajectory.shift: The withheld thing is in the room as an object, not as a thought he can file away. Work stops.
trajectory.trigger: She sets the relic between them and keeps her frosted hands in view.

trajectory.phase: on the weld being named as his decade
trajectory.shift: Disclosure moves. He becomes a man who has admitted the piece rather than a man who has only paid it.
trajectory.trigger: She lays out the wrong weight, the forty-year weld, and the inclusion as facts of the metal.

trajectory.phase: after the reasons are given and not collected
trajectory.shift: He has put the old year into her hearing and has not turned it into an order. He is still master by title and no longer the only keeper of the lie.
trajectory.trigger: She lets him finish the account and does not answer what she will do. The fire settles. Neither of them puts the relic back as if unread.

psychology.leaving_state: Admitted, still paying, still named master of the same house, reasons spoken as past and not asked as pardon. He does not know what she will do with the bar.
psychology.unresolved: Whether she will spend the recovery on the fraud, take the reading out of the house, or ask him for a ledger he has never kept.

dynamics.entering_state: In Willa's custody, publicly intact, unread by Orren as a named fact, already known to her as a forty-year forgery with his weld and his levy in the inclusion.
forces_acting: Willa's hands bringing it from the bench into the work room
her sentences naming mass, weld, and inclusion
Orren's look that receives the weld as his work
the six-day compact still requiring this object on a cloth
the banked fire's light that makes the mid-length join visible

axis_changes.from: recovered village token privately read as false
axis_changes.to: admitted forgery sitting between maker and reader, still required for the showing
axis_changes.caused_by: She sets it down and names the metal; he does not deny the weld or the levy.

axis_changes.from: known as forgery only to Willa
axis_changes.to: known as his weld and his tax to both people in the house
axis_changes.caused_by: The reading taken to him and received as work.

trajectory.shift: The bar leaves the status of a thing she handled alone after the return and becomes the object of a conversation.
trajectory.trigger: She sets it on the bench between them.

trajectory.shift: The stamp, the weld, and the inclusion are spoken. The piece is no longer able to pass inside this house as the old relic.
trajectory.trigger: He receives the weld as his own work and the inclusion as his own tax.

trajectory.shift: Neither of them wraps it or returns it to a cloth as if the reading had not happened. It remains intact and unpresented.
trajectory.trigger: The fire settles; no one puts the relic back as if unread.

dynamics.leaving_state: Still in Willa's custody, still unbroken, still unpresented, now an admitted false weight both of them have looked at as work.
dynamics.significance_shift: Before this unit it was the object she walked for. After this unit it is the object that made the house into a place where a forty-year kindness can be heard and not granted, and where the coming showing will be a choice rather than a retrieval.

dynamics.entering_state: Open, unnamed, paid only in work. The old reasons unheard. Raising and craft still the whole of the account; the lie not yet inside it as a spoken fact.
forces_acting: her choice to bring the reading here rather than down the path
his account of the slide year
the six days that will not be enough to clear a ledger
the house still calling itself a raising home

axis_changes.caused_by: He names the hunger of that winter and the closed pass as the ground of the weld, as history, not as a present plea.

axis_changes.to: raising, craft, and a spoken lie that kept the grain coming
axis_changes.caused_by: The admission of the weld and levy inside the house.

trajectory.shift: The debt is still the old question of what a raised child owes for life and teaching. The bar has entered the account but has not yet been given a year.
trajectory.trigger: She lays out the metal without a charge.

trajectory.phase: once the slide year is finished
trajectory.shift: The old reasons are in her hearing. They do not balance the account. Settlement remains open because no number has been offered or accepted.
trajectory.trigger: He says the reasons were good then and she lets him finish without granting them.

dynamics.leaving_state: Still open as a settlement. Old reasons heard as past and not granted as present. The lie is now inside the same account as the raising.
dynamics.significance_shift: What is owed is no longer only keep and craft. It is also the years the village ate on his body and the years she ate in a house that did not tell her. The concept can no longer be paid by another hinge finished before dark.

dynamics.entering_state: Raising home, both present, work and meals still one household. The night fire being banked as on any other late work-night.
forces_acting: the relic brought into the work room instead of left wrapped
two people stopping the ordinary close-of-day
sentences that have never been spoken at this fire
the cold that lives two steps from the hearth

axis_changes.from: the house that raised her and the only smithy Highkettle has
axis_changes.to: the house in which the false weight was made and has now been named, still used as a home
axis_changes.caused_by: The admission happening at this fire, where the piece was forged forty years ago.

trajectory.shift: Ordinary night work, both under the roof, the house still able to pretend the return was only a retrieval.
trajectory.trigger: She comes in from the bench with the bar.

trajectory.phase: after neither puts the relic back
trajectory.shift: The room is still the raising home in its state variables, but the shared silence is no longer only companionable. The house has heard itself.
trajectory.trigger: The fire settles; the bar remains between them as a named thing.

dynamics.leaving_state: Still both present, still officially the raising home. The work room has been used for an admission the household cannot metabolize as another finished task.
dynamics.significance_shift: The forge-house is no longer only the place that taught her true edges. It is the fire the false weight came from, and the room in which that fact was allowed to stand overnight.

interaction.what_collides: Willa wants the metal named as work he is owed to hear, and she wants the hamlet's winter kept off the table. Orren wants another untested showing and wants the knowledge kept off her. Her bringing the bar forces him to let her carry what he would have carried alone. His refusal to order her silence forces her to own the next act she came prepared only to refuse.
interaction.power_balance: She holds the object and the reading; he holds the history and the title of the house. Epistemic power equalizes when he admits. Household power does not yet move: he is still master, she is still the girl of the fire. He cannot compel her silence without spending her. She cannot compel a settled ledger because she cannot name what is owed. The compact, offstage, can still close the pass if either of them takes the piece public.
interaction.information_asymmetry: At the open she knows the weld is his and he does not know she has already read it as his; she does not know the slide-year account. By the close the metal-knowledge is shared, the old reasons are heard, and what she will do with the bar is known to neither of them as a decision. That last blank is what the scene buys: a six-day gap in which the house must live with an admitted fraud and an open ledger.
interaction.turning_point: The moment he does not deny — when he receives the weld as his own work and the inclusion as his own tax without first asking what she intends. The unit stops being a possible confrontation and becomes an admission. Her prepared no has nothing to attach to, and the relic left on the bench is no longer recoverable as unread.

established_facts_used.fact: Before she slept she read the recovered relic as a smith and found the wrong weight, Orren's forty-year weld, and an inclusion where a living levy sits.
established_facts_used.how_used: This scene exists to take that already-made reading to him rather than to generate the discovery again.

established_facts_used.fact: The relic is in Willa's custody, publicly intact, not yet presented.
established_facts_used.how_used: She can set the actual bar on the bench. The scene cannot break it or send it to the steward's table.

established_facts_used.fact: Her hands are frost-marked from the return crossing; stamina is badly spent.
established_facts_used.how_used: The damaged hands stay in view as the visible price of the hours in which he might have spoken first.

established_facts_used.fact: Orren forged the replacement in secret forty years ago and bound a living levy into the weld.
established_facts_used.how_used: His admission is of work he actually did, not a surprise the story invents tonight.

established_facts_used.fact: The original relic was lost in a slide year the hamlet could not have survived; his reasons were the grain, the pass, and the children still in the houses.
established_facts_used.how_used: These are the sentences he is allowed to speak as history. They must remain audible and not be granted as present.

established_facts_used.fact: A presentation-relic that is not the original holds the compact only while a living smith pays a hidden levy; the levy cannot be transferred, paused, or discharged except by his death or public breaking.
established_facts_used.how_used: He can name the inclusion as his tax. Neither of them can offer a transfer or a pause as a solution tonight.

established_facts_used.fact: The Hold does not police inner authenticity unless the object is publicly challenged or broken.
established_facts_used.how_used: His not asking her to take the reading to the Hold is coherent: the Hold has not asked. Her not taking it there tonight does not yet break the year.

established_facts_used.fact: He will not speak first if work can still postpone the speaking.
established_facts_used.how_used: Why she must bring the bar tonight, and why he does not open the subject himself.

established_facts_used.fact: He will not spend Willa as a fighter or as a confession, and he does not ask to be forgiven or dress a bill as a blessing.
established_facts_used.how_used: Locks beat 5: he does not ask her to hide the reading and does not ask pardon.

established_facts_used.fact: She speaks little and prefers the names of tools, weights, and tasks; she will not dress a feeling as a principle.
established_facts_used.how_used: Her beat is a reading, not a charge. The scene stays filmable as work-talk.

established_facts_used.fact: She takes the reading to him rather than to the village or the Hold.
established_facts_used.how_used: Determines the addressee of every sentence and keeps gr-01.knows_forgery false.

established_facts_used.fact: The crossing cost the hours in which Orren might have spoken first.
established_facts_used.how_used: Gives the frost on her hands a plot meaning: the missed hearing is already spent; this is her speaking, not his.

established_facts_used.fact: The false relic was made at this fire, not on a journey.
established_facts_used.how_used: The admission belongs in the work room of the forge-house, not at the chest or the midwinter ground.

established_facts_used.fact: This is a screenplay; state changes must land in what people say or pointedly refuse to say.
established_facts_used.how_used: relic_knowledge, disclosure, and old_reasons_status all move in spoken or refused speech, not in narration.

established_facts_used.fact: No redemptive confession may restore the household without cost.
established_facts_used.how_used: He admits manufacture. The house remains a raising home. The debt stays open. No embrace, no pardon, no restored unread.

constraints_honoured: plot_count remains 2: this unit advances pl-02:st4 and st5; pl-01 is present only as the six-day clock and the object both plots share.
Magic is a bill already being paid, never a key or a spectacle; the levy is named as his tax, not demonstrated.
No omniscient dip into Orren will appear on the page; the scene is third-limited on Willa; his interior is planned here and leaked only through look, poker, and word-choice.
No worldbuilding lecture: no mechanism of binding, no glossary, no Hold procedure beyond a showing that does not test.
Hold remains offstage; gr-03 is referenced, not faced.
She thinks in work; moral confusion arrives as who is owed the reading, not as a theme-statement.
Village poverty stays in thin soup, scale-smell, patched wool, and a fire that fails two steps from the hearth.
No romance, no third plot, no prophecy, no raiders as tonight's antagonist.
Forbidden tics: no prophetic cadence, no she-did-not-know-then, no weather as cheap fallacy, no camera directions, no closing snowfall as absolution.
Household role and household_character must not jump to the end-state of pl-02:st10 tonight.

contradictions_checked.risk: Orren explains how a living levy is bound into an inclusion, turning the admission into a lore scene.
contradictions_checked.avoided_by: He receives the inclusion as his tax and names the year that required the weld. No process, no words of binding.

contradictions_checked.risk: She decides tonight to break, tell, or present, collapsing st6–st8 into this fire.
contradictions_checked.avoided_by: Beat 5: she does not yet answer what she will do. debt_account stays unsettled; belonging stays of_the_house.

contradictions_checked.risk: He asks forgiveness or she grants the old reasons, producing the cheap redemption the root forbids.
contradictions_checked.avoided_by: He offers history, not a plea, and does not ask pardon. She lets him finish and does not grant that the reasons still hold. old_reasons_status goes only to heard_as_past.

contradictions_checked.risk: The village or the Hold learns, forcing a public challenge the world-rules would have to answer.
contradictions_checked.avoided_by: The reading stays in the work room. No messenger, no clerk, no hearth-gossip. lo-04.aware_of_forgery and gr-01.knows_forgery remain false.

contradictions_checked.risk: The relic changes custody or is damaged, breaking the compact or stealing pl-01:st8.
contradictions_checked.avoided_by: custody remains willa; publicly_intact remains true; neither of them treats the bar as something to hide in his chest or to test to destruction.

contradictions_checked.risk: The fire settling is written as moral weather, violating the pathetic-fallacy ban.
contradictions_checked.avoided_by: The fire is work he was already banking; its settling is the sound of that work stopping, photographable, not a comment on the lie.

contradictions_checked.risk: This admission makes the later unforgiven naming (pl-02:st9) redundant.
contradictions_checked.avoided_by: Tonight is manufacture admitted and reasons heard as past. st9 remains a post-rite renaming that refuses pardon after she has already presented. Different night, different force.

forward_commitments: ev-009 / pl-02:st6 must show that the reasons just heard as past are not defensible now: the village has been paying iron for a right that is only his bodily tax.
debt_account must remain unsettled through the next unit; the unpaid ledger (st7) needs days, not a speech tonight.
She must not tell the village or the Hold before the showing; lo-04 and gr-01 stay ignorant so pl-01:st8 can be an untested acceptance.
The piece must remain publicly intact and available for presentation; no breaking, no challenge.
pl-02:st8's partition (winter the forge, leave when the pass opens, not keep the lie after he dies) cannot be spoken yet or the point of no return has no ground to stand on.
pl-02:st9's unforgiven naming after the rite must not repeat tonight's sentences; tonight is admission of manufacture, that night is refusal to grant.
Orren remains levy_paying and master_of_house until a later unit moves those axes.
The six-day clock is now a shared clock: both of them know the object they will have to carry or refuse.

decision.resolution: sc-008 is the night in the forge-house, six days before the rite, in which Willa sets the recovered bar between them and names the wrong weight, the forty-year weld, and the inclusion as metal, and Orren admits the work and the levy and gives the slide year as history without asking her to hide the reading or deciding the next act. The house hears itself and does not yet change its name.

state_changes_implied.because: She speaks the reading to him in the work room and keeps custody while she does.
He does not deny the weld or the levy and receives both as his.
He names the slide year, the hunger, and the closed pass as the ground of the weld, as history, not as a present plea.

risks: Dialogue that names the compact too completely will read as a worldbuilding lecture even if each sentence is in-character.
If her silence after the reasons looks like assent, the adult reader will think the old year has been granted and st6 will have nothing to reverse.
If his admission is played as relief or tenderness, the house will feel redeemed before anyone has paid.
Spec-script interiority could leak in — a look held too long, an unfilmable knowledge of his shame — and break the single-POV screenplay rule.
Keeping the bar on the bench without a next-act button may feel like a stalled scene unless the refused request (he does not ask her to hide it) is playable enough to raise the tension to 82.
